technical.summary: Bullish long-term structure with strong moving average alignment and candlestick confirmation, but overbought short-term conditions and weak ADX trend strength limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: FANG shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 89 days present material risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 17) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member provides minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (397.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent FOMC event create severely adverse macro conditions for energy sector trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term technical structure (price above 200-EMA, EMA 50/200 bullish, three white soldiers, supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (VIX crisis) creates classic contrarian buy setup at support zone.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought short-term conditions (StochRSI, Williams %R), weak ADX trend strength, negative Awesome Oscillator divergence, zero fundamental conviction, imminent FOMC event, and macro headwinds (rising DXY, flat yield curve, VIX crisis) make swing entry high-risk with poor risk/reward.

decision.entry_rationale: Long-term technical structure (price above 200-EMA, three white soldiers, supertrend bullish) offers contrarian appeal in extreme fear environment. However, overbought short-term conditions, weak trend strength (ADX false), and zero fundamental conviction create asymmetric risk unsuitable for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent FOMC event combined with VIX crisis (397.6), rising DXY headwind, and negative Awesome Oscillator divergence create macro conditions likely to trigger sharp reversal before swing target realization.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical bullish but fundamentals, sentiment, and risk agents all flag material concerns; debate decisively favors bear case (8 vs 4).
decision.portfolio_note: Already 31 positions in Energy sector; adding FANG increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without offsetting fundamental or smart money support.
